THE CALLER REPORTED THAT A VESSEL RAN AGROUND OFF A PRIVATE PRIVATE PROPERTY AT OR NEAR THE OLD BRIDGE ROAD ON UNKNOWN DATE. THE USCG FOUND THE VESSEL DURING A PATROL ON APR. 07, 2017. SO FAR, THE VESSEL HAD THE FUEL AND OILY MIXTURES PUMPED OUT (APPX. 1,500 GALLONS TOTAL) BY THE USCG AND THE KEY COMPONENTS OF THE VESSEL HAVE BEEN REMOVED BY THE OWNER. AS OF DATE OF THIS REPORTING (MAY 23, 2017), THE VESSEL IS STILL GROUNDED AT THE SAME LOCATION. THE OWNER OF THE BOAT IS YET HAVE A FINAL PLAN TO HOW AND WHEN THE VESSEL WILL BE TOWED AWAY.
